tools.name: console_discover
tools.answers: The served entity roster from the console's own contract (OPTIONS /api/): every path template it serves, which rows are pump-fed (measured only while watched), and which carry declared travels and defaults. Optional substring filter over paths.

tools.name: console_get
tools.answers: GET one row by path (e.g. /channel/input/3/fader). The console's status, Allow header and body come back as they are.

tools.name: console_options
tools.answers: OPTIONS one row: what it MAY be — its methods, fields, travels (limit/taper), writability and instances, as the console declares them.

tools.name: console_patch
tools.answers: PATCH one row with a JSON delta. A REAL WRITE to a desk, sent exactly once and never retried; the console's answer — status, Allow, and the body with its fault, refusal and reason — is returned verbatim.

tools.name: console_health
tools.answers: The console's health row: engine, graph and xrun state as it reports them. Reads /health when the contract serves it; answers the console's no-such-resource fault when it does not.

tools.name: console_warnings
tools.answers: The console's current warnings. Reads /warnings when the contract serves it; answers the console's no-such-resource fault when it does not.

tools.name: console_meters
tools.answers: One reading of the meter frame, decoded through the windows /meters declares on OPTIONS, projected to the strips asked for (channel keys like "input/1"; all strips when omitted). A pump-fed row measures only while watched, so an unmeasured GET is followed by ONE watch that is closed the moment the first measured frame lands — no stream is held.

tools.name: console_takes
tools.answers: The recorder's take library. Reads /takes when the contract serves it; answers the console's no-such-resource fault when it does not.

tools.name: console_history
tools.answers: Where the desk sits in its journal: the undo/redo cursor. Reads /history/cursor when the contract serves it; answers the console's no-such-resource fault when it does not.

tools.name: rig_journal
tools.answers: The history ring: the journal newest-first, with the cursor and the ring's bound. Reads /history when the contract serves it; answers the console's no-such-resource fault when it does not.

tools.name: rig_links
tools.answers: The patchbay as the console serves it: the external route memory (/patchbay/external, the links the graph showed) and the node view (/patchbay/nodes). Read through REST rows only; a row the contract does not serve is named under "unserved".

tools.name: law_governs
tools.answers: The governing spec and the law line for each path, from .claude/spec-map.txt with the design gate's own matching (a shell glob as a prefix, first row wins). An ungoverned path is reported as such.

tools.name: rulings_search
tools.answers: Search the design corpus (the design specs and the working notes, archive excluded). Mode "rag" asks the knowledge MCP on the cluster when it is reachable AND indexes an openmixer source; otherwise mode "local" ranks paragraphs in the tree. Every result names its mode and what searched.

tools.name: traps_recall
tools.answers: The traps that have cost real time, from the "traps" section of the tree's local CLAUDE.md, ranked against the query (empty query: all of them). Read at call time; a tree without the file says so.

tools.name: compliance_preflight
tools.answers: Before editing: for each path, the governing spec and law, the traps its words recall, and the conformance/ratchet suites that reach it (with the evidence: an import, a named prefix, or a tree walk). The suites listed are the ones to run after the edit.

tools.name: jobs_proofs
tools.answers: The job-level round-trip ledger as data: an internal design record, row by row, with the tier number, whether the job is proven (tier 1) or owed, the test a proven row cites and the shadow probe the deploy gate runs for it.

env.name: OPENMIXER_CONSOLE
env.meaning: base URL of the console the console_*/rig_* tools talk to; named in every result

env.name: OPENMIXER_KNOWLEDGE_MCP
env.meaning: Streamable-HTTP URL of the knowledge MCP rulings_search asks first
